ClusterDestination.description: Argo CD's identity for a concrete cluster.

name.description: Argo CD registered cluster name. Exactly one of `server` and `name` must be non-null.

server.description: Kubernetes API server URL. Exactly one of `server` and `name` must be non-null.

ClusterKubernetesCapabilities.description: Kubernetes discovery information used for deterministic offline rendering.

apiVersions.description: API versions exposed to Helm. An empty list is valid for scaffolding; target rendering requires at least one entry.

kubeVersion.description: Kubernetes version exposed to Helm. May be omitted for scaffolding; required for target rendering.

ClusterLiveConfiguration.description: Local-only connection settings for live operations against a cluster.

context.description: Local kubeconfig context. Live commands prefer an explicit `--context`, then this value, then the current kubeconfig context.

destination.description: Exactly one concrete Argo CD destination, identified by server URL or registered cluster name.

kubernetes.description: Committed Kubernetes capabilities for deterministic offline rendering. Target rendering requires a version and at least one API version.

live.description: Local connection settings. Omitted from templates and render hashes.

values.description: Cluster facts merged recursively with target values; target values win.

GitOpsResourceMetadata.description: Metadata shared by local GitOps compiler resources.

labels.description: Literal labels used for organization and target selection.

name.description: Project-local identity. Must be a Kubernetes DNS subdomain and remain static during discovery.

description:
Describes a concrete Kubernetes destination and its deterministic rendering capabilities.

Cluster values supply reusable facts; target values take precedence. This is compiler configuration and is not emitted as a workload manifest.

apiVersion.description: API group and version defining this resource.

kind.description: Resource kind within the API group.

title: Cluster
